data.name: Mangrove Wilderness Boat Tour
data.headline: Starting at $65 | 1hr 45min | All Ages | 6 passenger vessels
data.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure through Everglades National Park on our Mangrove Wilderness Tour! Over 1 hour and 45 minutes, we’ll navigate the backcountry mangroves of the 10,000 islands.

meeting_point.address: 905 Copeland Ave S Everglades City, FL US 34139

data.what_is_included:
Your expert guide will highlight the distinct traits of various mangrove species and explain the diverse ecosystem of Everglades National Park. Keep your eyes peeled for Alligators, Dolphins, manatees, and over 300 bird species that inhabit this remarkable
landscape.
data.what_to_bring:
- National Park Pass
- Guests should consider bringing sunglasses, a hat, sunscreen, and water.
- Snacks, Drinks, and Souvenirs are available in the gift shop before departure.
data.cancellation_notes:
Customers will receive a full refund if cancellation is made more than 24 hours prior to the reserved tour time. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. We reserve the right to cancel tours if there are less than six people. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.

Visit our parks, donate, become a member.  Your support benefits Big Cypress National Preserve, Biscayne National Park, Dry Tortugas, and Everglades National Park.

data.booking_notes:
![EC Logo](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/Di5XfrGRR4CxBVUCBxK1)
# Arrival Information
Please meet us at the lookout Gift Shop under the 10,000 Islands Observation Tower @ 905 Copeland Ave in Everglades City, Just after the Gulf Coast Visitor Center entrance. Bring a hat, sunglasses, and bug spray. We have water and Grab N Go items for purchase in the gift shop. Look forward to seeing you!

## What to Bring:


- Sunglasses
- A Hat
- Sunscreen
- Water
- Rain gear (such as a poncho) is recommended for days when rainy weather is expected. 
- National Park Pass

Trips board 5 min before departing and everyone needs to present for the safety briefing.
We do our best to ensure that trips leave at their scheduled departure, so it is very important to be on time! 
- Vessel is not ADA accessible
- No ramp to board the boat
- Open top on vessel so it can enter mangrove tunnels
